reply.text:
I won't point you to one. Ranking SARMs by how safe they are is dosing-and-drug advice, and that's a doctor's call, not a coach's. What I will say in general terms: they're unapproved, the quality of what's in a bottle from a private seller is unverified, and they can affect your hormones and liver. If you're considering them, talk to a doctor and get bloodwork first.

What I can do is look at your training. If you're after faster progress, tell me which lift or goal you're chasing and we'll see what's holding it back. It's usually programming, food, or sleep.
